description: Maps ECHO's Python matrix state to Cloudflare KV and D1

kv_namespaces.name: ECHO_STATE
kv_namespaces.description: ECHO's live operational state — generation, coherency, active queues
kv_namespaces.python_source: Runtime state — set during evolution and pipeline runs

kv_namespaces.name: ECHO_VGM
kv_namespaces.description: Validated Generalization Matrix — axiom tier entries

kv_namespaces.name: ECHO_LRM
kv_namespaces.description: Logic and Reasoning Matrix — theorem tier entries

value_schema.sources: list of strings (VGM ids or law ids)

kv_namespaces.name: ECHO_MATRIX
kv_namespaces.description: Algorithm Matrix — registered algorithms A-000 through A-158+

d1_databases.description: ECHO's main knowledge store — agents, ties, neighborhoods, formulas

tables.name: ties
tables.python_source: agent.ties set for each agent in lobby

wrangler_toml:
# wrangler.toml — ECHO Governor Cloudflare Configuration
# Generated by DeploymentTranslator (A-157)
# Replace all REPLACE_WITH_* values with actual IDs

name = "echo-green-future"
main = "src/index.js"
compatibility_date = "2024-09-01"

[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "ECHO_STATE"
id = "REPLACE_WITH_ECHO_STATE_KV_ID"

[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "ECHO_VGM"
id = "REPLACE_WITH_ECHO_VGM_KV_ID"

[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "ECHO_LRM"
id = "REPLACE_WITH_ECHO_LRM_KV_ID"

[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "ECHO_MATRIX"
id = "REPLACE_WITH_ECHO_MATRIX_KV_ID"

[[d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_name = "echo_knowledge"
database_id = "REPLACE_WITH_D1_DATABASE_ID"
migration_sql:
-- ECHO Governor D1 Migration
-- Generated by DeploymentTranslator (A-157)
-- Run via: wrangler d1 execute echo_knowledge --file=migration.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agents (
  word TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  department TEXT,
  entry_class TEXT,
  generality_score REAL,
  definition TEXT,
  neighborhood TEXT,
  study_group_type TEXT,
  created_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_dept ON agents(department);
CREATE INDEX idx_gen ON agents(generality_score);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ties (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  word_a TEXT,
  word_b TEXT,
  tie_weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
  tie_source TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_word_a ON ties(word_a);
CREATE INDEX idx_word_b ON ties(word_b);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wordnet_chains (
  word TEXT,
  synset TEXT,
  chain_json TEXT,
  depth INTEGER,
  definition TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS etymology (
  word TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  root TEXT,
  root_language TEXT,
  original_meaning TEXT,
  chain_json TEXT,
  lhea_validation TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS formulas (
  alg_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  expression TEXT,
  domain TEXT,
  variables_json TEXT,
  law TEXT,
  vgm_abstraction TEXT,
  lrm_form TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS geosensory_endpoints (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  url TEXT,
  domain TEXT,
  sensor_type TEXT,
  key_required INTEGER,
  format TEXT,
  fields_json TEXT,
  jurisdiction TEXT,
  lhea_letter TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  last_validated TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'discovered'
);
CREATE INDEX idx_domain ON geosensory_endpoints(domain);
CREATE INDEX idx_sensor ON geosensory_endpoints(sensor_type);
